question: Find literature evidence describing strategies for improving the performance of SnO2-based n-i-p perovskite solar cells. Give the strategy, mechanism, and supporting citation.
final_answer:
**Strategy:** Chloride-additive engineering of the perovskite absorber (FACl added during antisolvent deposition) combined with surface passivation by 1-adamantylamine hydrochloride (ADAHCl), applied in a SnO2-based planar n-i-p perovskite solar cell.

**Mechanism:** The FACl additive controls perovskite crystallization and reduces the small-grain capping layer/recombination; subsequent ADAHCl treatment passivates the perovskite surface, retarding surface recombination (shown by PL and EIS) and improving film quality at the SnO2/perovskite interface.

**Citation:** DOI 10.1002/aenm.201803587 — "Controllable Perovskite Crystallization via Antisolvent Technique Using Chloride Additives for Highly Efficient Planar Perovskite Solar Cells." Reported result for the SnO2-based planar PSC: PCE 21.2%, Voc 1152 mV, low hysteresis, and 88% of initial PCE retained after 700 h.

**Could not establish:** The other high-scoring result (DOI 10.1016/j.electacta.2017.12.108) concerns Sn-doped TiO2, not SnO2, so it does not support an SnO2-specific claim. The retrieved evidence did not provide further distinct SnO2-ETL strategies (e.g., ETL doping, interface modifiers, bilayer SnO2), so those remain unverified here.
